tests_added: examples/demo-kit/test/coverage-scope.test.ts::parseLcov reads per-file line and branch totals, keyed by kit-relative POSIX path from a Windows path or a file:// URL
examples/demo-kit/test/coverage-scope.test.ts::mergeScope lists a tree file the lcov never mentions at 0 of its line count, unreached, and omits no tree file
examples/demo-kit/test/coverage-scope.test.ts::headline prints the whole-tree figure with its population, and the reached-only figure only beside it
examples/demo-kit/test/coverage-scope.test.ts::gate fails a floored file below its floor, naming file, floor and actual, and fails a floored file the run did not reach
examples/demo-kit/test/coverage-scope.test.ts::gate fails a floor whose path is no longer in the tree, so the gated population cannot shrink silently
examples/demo-kit/test/coverage-scope.test.ts::ratchet raises a floor to floor(actual), never lowers one, and reports a floor above the measured figure
examples/demo-kit/test/coverage-scope.test.ts::listTree derives src/**/*.ts(x), template/lib/*.ts and root *.ts from the filesystem, so a new file appears with no config edit
examples/demo-kit/test/coverage-scope.test.ts::guard: the package's coverage run executes the same tests as the plain node --test run
deviations_from_card: (1) The tree also includes the kit's root *.ts (adopt.ts, added in r2 and tested at 83% lines but invisible to a src/template-only include); coverage include adds *.ts with test/** and scripts/** excluded. Tree = 49 files, not 47. (2) Floors: the card's 15 pure modules plus template/lib/acts.ts (self-declared pure, r2) = 16, seeded at floor(measured) via --update; src/webmcp/door.ts branches hand-seeded at 92, not 93: Node's merged lcov carried one extra zero-hit branch range in 3 of 27 runs (88 vs 87 branches, 92.05% vs 93.10%), so 93 would flake. Recorded in ADR 0184. (3) lcov goes to node_modules/.demo-kit-coverage.lcov, not node_modules/.cache/demo-kit-coverage/ (Node's reporter does not create directories). (4) The guard case (7) pins the package wiring (reads scripts.test and runs its argv with TAP vs a plain run), so it was red before too (script had no coverage flag); 8/8 red before rather than 7. (5) One commit instead of two. (6) README: one sentence at :12-13 rewritten (it said typecheck runs the suite, now false), Coverage section appended at the end - no reflow.
notes: Measured: whole tree 55.4% of lines over 49 of 49 files; reached-only 93.1% over 27 (22 unreached: hooks/components, useCameraRig.ts 658 lines). Root `pnpm test` not run (it includes the journey e2e the brief forbids, and the change touches no runtime code consumers import); demo-kit test run green 221/221. For card A next wave: (a) escape.ts is floored at 100/100 lines/branches - escapeIntent must be fully tested or the gate fails; (b) test/escape.test.ts:3 still claims it is 'Run by pnpm --filter @athena/demo-kit typecheck' - typecheck is now tsc only, the claim belongs to `test` (card A owns that file); (c) if card A extends tsconfig include to test/**, consider scripts/** too (scripts/coverage.ts type-checks clean under allowImportingTsExtensions). Changing a floored pure module's coverage downward now turns `pnpm --filter @athena/demo-kit test` red; run `node scripts/coverage.ts --update` to raise floors after adding tests.
